Build Muscle Faster 
The PROMINO™ patented, plant-based formula is backed by over 20 years of research and more than 25 clinical trials to find the precise ratio of Essential Amino Acids (EAA's) in order to accelerate Muscle Protein Synthesis (MPS). 
Each serving of PROMINO™ provides your body with the key building blocks needed to build and repair muscle faster. PROMINO™ is so potent it has been shown to be 2X MORE EFFECTIVE THAN OH WHEY PROTEIN+ at increasing MPS, even at rest. 
PROMINO™ is simply more effective at producing the desired results - with none of the fat, sugar, carbs and bloat. It's time to Rethink Protein. 
So where's the protein?
When you eat protein, your body must first break it down to extract the amino acids used to grow and repair muscle fibers. PROMINO™ provides your body with these protein building blocks directly, without the excess calories, filler, carbohydrates and uptake delay of whey and other protein sources.

Digestible Indispensable Amino Acid Score (DIAAS) is the new standard for measuring protein quality and ranks how a protein source is actually absorbed and utilized by the body. Gram per gram, nothing is higher in protein quality than PROMINO™.
PROMINO is NSF Certified Sport!
PROMINO is manufactured in a cGMP, FDA registered facility. Every ingredient and lot are tested to ensure the highest standards in efficacy and safety.

Suggested use
Mix 1 scoop of PROMINO with 24 fl oz of cold water, consume immediately after a workout or between meals on non-training days. 
Other ingredients
Citric acid, sucralose, gum arabic, cellulose gum, carrot and blackcurrant extract (color), natural flavors, stevia leaf extract. 
Made in the U.S.A. from domestic and imported ingredients. 
Warnings
Not intended for use by persons under 18. Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult a medical doctor if you have a medical condition, are taking medications or before starting any diet or exercise program. Do not use if pouch is torn or damaged. Store in a cool, dry place, 15-30℃ (59-86°F). Keep out of reach of children.
